g.text: Container diagram for AX state, directory, terminal-runtime, enrichment, continuation, and cloning boundaries.
Launches and orchestrates transactions via JSON-over-stdio
Browses, selects, confirms, launches, and attaches
Submits typed projected reads and guarded mutations
Queries and confirms exact directory plans
Rebuilds derived catalog and search index
Delegates managed activation or ownership-neutral attach
Delegates existing AX ownership and provider effects
Uses Provider 2 and companion Session Adapter 1 transactions
Requests AX-authorized create, attach, reconnect, stop, or restore
Creates/attests dedicated private -S server on macOS
Invokes provider lifecycle only through AX authorization
Owns logical session, lease/fencing, workspace, checkpoint, and evidence state
